name: EU AI Act Ready Agent (eu-ai-act.ro)
description: Machine-readable EU AI Act readiness agent operated by AIVENTURE S.R.L. (CUI 51415878, Bucuresti, Romania). Answers questions about Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 obligations, applicable deadlines, and the ten governance modules, and returns content fingerprints for published signal files. Supports readiness. Does NOT certify, satisfy or attest conformity - official verification remains with the competent authority.

skills.name: EU AI Act Applicability Timeline
skills.description: Returns the published application dates for Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 obligations as they stand after the June 2026 Digital Omnibus, including Article 50 transparency, generated-content marking, and the two high-risk tranches. Deterministic lookup of a published table, not legal advice.
examples: When does Article 50 of the EU AI Act start applying?
What EU AI Act obligations apply to a Romanian SME in 2027?
Care sunt termenele EU AI Act pentru sisteme cu risc ridicat?

skills.name: Governance Module Lookup
skills.description: Returns the structure of the ten EU AI Act governance modules - AI system inventory, risk classification, AI literacy, prohibited practices, high-risk assessment, technical documentation, human oversight, data governance, logging and monitoring, incident reporting - and the seven document types produced per module: policy, procedure, work instruction, checklist, register, declaration, evidence.
examples: Which documents does the risk classification module produce?
What are the ten governance modules?
Ce contine modulul de supraveghere umana?

skills.name: Canonical Entity Lookup
skills.description: Returns the published entity graph and legal identity of the operator: legal name, CUI 51415878, EUID, trade register number, registered office, founder, partner relationships and sibling nodes in the network. Deterministic read of published signals.
examples: Return the entity graph for this site

skills.name: Content Fingerprint
skills.description: Returns the SHA-256 content fingerprint published for a signal file on this domain, so a calling agent can download the file, re-hash it and confirm it has not changed. This domain publishes content fingerprints only. It does NOT use blockchain or OpenTimestamps anchoring, and any claim of blockchain attestation for eu-ai-act.ro would be false.
examples: What is the content fingerprint for entities.json?
How can I verify this site's published signals?
